008package paint.shared.config.paintconfig;
009
010import com.google.gson.Gson;
011import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
012import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
013import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
014
015import java.nio.file.Path;
016
017import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON;
018
019/**
020 * Thin façade over a JSON-backed config store. Keeps the original public/static API intact.
021 * <p>
022 * Provides a high-level API (façade) for accessing and managing the central "Paint
023 * Configuration.json" file.
024 * </p>
025 * <p>
026 * The {@code PaintConfig} class serves as the primary entry point for reading and writing
027 * application settings. It organizes configuration into sections (e.g., "Generate Squares",
028 * "TrackMate") and supports case-insensitive key lookups. It ensures that default values are
029 * populated if a configuration file is missing and handles reinitialization when switching
030 * projects.
031 * </p>
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>Singleton-based access to application-wide configuration.</li>
034 *   <li>Section-based organization of settings.</li>
035 *   <li>Automatic default value population via {@link DefaultConfigLoader}.</li>
036 *   <li>Fault-tolerant loading with automatic backup of invalid files.</li>
037 *   <li>Case-insensitive key retrieval.</li>
038 * </ul>
039 */
040public class PaintConfig {
041
042    // ============================================================================
043    // Singleton + Shared Resources
044    // ============================================================================
045
046    private static volatile PaintConfig INSTANCE;
047    /* package */ static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();
048
049    private final Path        path;
050    private final ConfigStore store;
051    private final JsonCase    jsonCase;
052
053    private PaintConfig(Path path) {
054        this.path     = path;
055        this.jsonCase = new JsonCase();
056        this.store    = new ConfigStore(path, GSON);
057    }
058
059    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
060    // Initialisation
061    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
062
063    /** Initialize for a given project root (creates file if missing). */
064    public static void initialise(Path projectPath) {
065        Path configPath = projectPath.resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
066        if (INSTANCE == null) {
067            synchronized (PaintConfig.class) {
068                if (INSTANCE == null) {
069                    INSTANCE = new PaintConfig(configPath);
070                    INSTANCE.store.ensureLoaded(() -> DefaultConfigLoader.loadDefaults(INSTANCE.store));
071                    // Defensive: an existing config file may pre-date a key or be
072                    // missing one. Add any absent default (existing values are kept)
073                    // and persist once, so the file is always complete.
074                    if (DefaultConfigLoader.backfillMissing(INSTANCE.store)) {
075                        INSTANCE.store.save();
076                    }
077                }
078            }
079        } else {
080            Path expected = projectPath.resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
081            if (!INSTANCE.path.equals(expected)) {
082                PaintLogger.warnf("PaintConfig already initialised at %s (attempted reinit with %s)\n",
083                                  INSTANCE.path, expected);
084            }
085        }
086    }
087
088    /** Force reinitialisation to a new project root. */
089    public static void reinitialise(Path projectPath) {
090        synchronized (PaintConfig.class) {
091            INSTANCE = null;
092            initialise(projectPath);
093            PaintLogger.debugf("PaintConfig reinitialised at %s",
094                               projectPath.resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON));
095        }
096    }
097
098    /** Access singleton (lazy-inits to user-home if needed). */
099    public static PaintConfig instance() {
100        if (INSTANCE == null) {
101            Path defaultPath = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"), PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
102            initialise(defaultPath);
103        }
104        return INSTANCE;
105    }
106
107    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
108    // Persistence
109    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
110
111    public void save() {
112        store.save();
113    }
114
115    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
116    // Sweep defaults file (same behavior, new home calls writer)
117    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
118
119    public void setSweepDefaults(Path projectPath) {
120        SweepConfigWriter.writeDefaultSweepJson(projectPath);
121    }

123    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
124    // Instance API
125    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
126
127    public String getStringValue(String section, String key, String def) {
128        JsonObject sec = getSection(section);
129        if (sec != null) {
130            String real = jsonCase.findKeyIgnoreCase(sec, key);
131            if (real != null && sec.get(real).isJsonPrimitive()) {
132                return sec.getAsJsonPrimitive(real).getAsString();
133            }
134        }
135        PaintLogger.warnf("No value for '%s' found, default '%s' applied", key, def);
136        // A read must not touch disk (A4): cache the default in memory only.
137        setStringValue(section, key, def, false);
138        return def;
139    }
140
141    public int getIntValue(String section, String key, int def) {
142        JsonObject sec = getSection(section);
143        if (sec != null) {
144            String real = jsonCase.findKeyIgnoreCase(sec, key);
145            if (real != null && sec.get(real).isJsonPrimitive()) {
146                try {
147                    return sec.getAsJsonPrimitive(real).getAsInt();
148                } catch (Exception ignored) {
149                    PaintLogger.warnf("Invalid '%s', default %d applied", real, def);
150                    setIntValue(section, key, def, false);
151                }
152            }
153        }
154        PaintLogger.warnf("No value for '%s', default %d applied", key, def);
155        // A read must not touch disk (A4): cache the default in memory only.
156        setIntValue(section, key, def, false);
157        return def;
158    }
159
160    public double getDoubleValue(String section, String key, double def) {
161        JsonObject sec = getSection(section);
162        if (sec != null) {
163            String real = jsonCase.findKeyIgnoreCase(sec, key);
164            if (real != null && sec.get(real).isJsonPrimitive()) {
165                try {
166                    return sec.getAsJsonPrimitive(real).getAsDouble();
167                } catch (Exception ignored) {
168                    PaintLogger.warnf("Invalid '%s', default %.2f applied", real, def);
169                    setDoubleValue(section, key, def, false);
170                }
171            }
172        }
173        PaintLogger.warnf("No value for '%s', default %.2f applied", key, def);
174        // A read must not touch disk (A4): cache the default in memory only.
175        setDoubleValue(section, key, def, false);
176        return def;
177    }
178
179    public boolean getBooleanValue(String section, String key, boolean def) {
180        JsonObject sec = getSection(section);
181        if (sec != null) {
182            String real = jsonCase.findKeyIgnoreCase(sec, key);
183            if (real != null && sec.get(real).isJsonPrimitive()) {
184                try {
185                    return sec.getAsJsonPrimitive(real).getAsBoolean();
186                } catch (Exception ignored) { /* fallthrough */ }
187            }
188        }
189        PaintLogger.warnf("No value for '%s', default %b applied", key, def);
190        // A read must not touch disk (A4): cache the default in memory only.
191        setBooleanValue(section, key, def, false);
192        return def;
193    }
194
195    public boolean getBooleanValueNoWarning(String section, String key, boolean def) {
196        JsonObject sec = getSection(section);
197        if (sec != null) {
198            String real = jsonCase.findKeyIgnoreCase(sec, key);
199            if (real != null && sec.get(real).isJsonPrimitive()) {
200                try {
201                    return sec.getAsJsonPrimitive(real).getAsBoolean();
202                } catch (Exception ignored) { /* fallthrough */ }
203            }
204        }
205        // A read must not touch disk (A4): cache the default in memory only.
206        setBooleanValue(section, key, def, false);
207        return def;
208    }
209
210    public void setStringValue(String section, String key, String value, boolean autoSave) {
211        JsonObject sec = store.getOrCreateSection(section);
212        sec.addProperty(key, value);
213        if (autoSave) {
214            save();
215        }
216    }
217
218    public void setIntValue(String section, String key, int value, boolean autoSave) {
219        JsonObject sec = store.getOrCreateSection(section);
220        sec.addProperty(key, value);
221        if (autoSave) {
222            save();
223        }
224    }
225
226    public void setDoubleValue(String section, String key, double value, boolean autoSave) {
227        JsonObject sec = store.getOrCreateSection(section);
228        sec.addProperty(key, value);
229        if (autoSave) {
230            save();
231        }
232    }
233
234    public void setBooleanValue(String section, String key, boolean value, boolean autoSave) {
235        JsonObject sec = store.getOrCreateSection(section);
236        sec.addProperty(key, value);
237        if (autoSave) {
238            save();
239        }
240    }
241
242    @Override public String toString() {
243        return GSON.toJson(store.root());
244    }
245
246    public void removeValue(String section, String key, boolean autoSave) {
247        JsonObject sec = getSection(section);
248        if (sec != null) {
249            String real = jsonCase.findKeyIgnoreCase(sec, key);
250            if (real != null) {
251                sec.remove(real);
252                if (autoSave) save();
253            }
254        }
255    }
256
257    public void removeSectionValue(String section, boolean autoSave) {
258        store.removeSection(section);
259        if (autoSave) {
260            save();
261        }
262    }
263
264    public static void remove (String s, String k) {
265        instance().removeValue (s, k, true);
266    }
267
268    public static void removeSection(String s) {
269        instance().removeSectionValue(s, true);
270    }
